scope: Israel and Hezbollah art files referenced by RTSAI-Mod rules or sequences but absent from modern-factions/ART-PROVENANCE.json.

generator.repo: OpenRA-AI (local; commit not on origin when bound)
generator.kind: project-geometry: CPU renders and exports of meshes defined in Python. Inputs: project code, project material colours, OpenRA's GPL-3.0 voxel normal table (format data) and the GPL-2.0 FreeSans font used only for Classic icons. No image, SHP, VXL, HVA, PAL or MIX input.

method.generator-record: SHA-256 of the mod file equals the hash build-levant-art.py stored in levant-art-provenance.json when it wrote the file. Re-checked on every sync.
method.reproduced: build-levant-art.py at 18eb108, re-run in a temporary sandbox (PIL 12.3.0 python 3.12.10), wrote a byte-identical file.
method.copy-of-recorded: Bytes equal a same-type file already recorded in ART-PROVENANCE.json; the entry inherits that record. Re-checked on every sync.
